purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for remote sharing scopes, `all/ext/id` input modes, projected fields, peer bindings, delegated writes and local-vs-remote governance decisions.

topics.name: DWH Remote Sharing Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for remote sharing scopes, `all/ext/id` input modes, projected fields, peer bindings, delegated writes and local-vs-remote governance decisions.

semantics.identity_rule: Source resource, sharing scope, peer, endpoint, projection and write-delegation identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing remote scope/delegation grants no read/write authority.
semantics.action_rule: create/edit/revoke-share/delegate-write/revoke-write operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual source→scope→peer→projection/delegation edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.derived_rule: Effective access is displayed as a derived governance result, not as semantic ownership.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing scope, denied field, revoked delegation and target-side rejection are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: Remote DWH sharing exposes only explicitly scoped and schema-governed data; transport reachability, endpoint registration, local authorization or broader local ownership never silently expands delegated remote rights.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates peer and endpoint identity
monitor grants write by toggling UI without explicit operation
local access displayed as remote delegation

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for remote sharing scopes, `all/ext/id` input modes, projected fields, peer bindings, delegated writes and local-vs-remote governance decisions.
